fact: Under the USAID-funded eSCMIS project, Ministry of Health staff are being brought into software development, deployment, training and technical support so the Ministry can take over ownership of the eLMIS, with MOH eLMIS support officers supporting facility sites.
title: Zambia's Ministry of Health taking charge of technical support and oversight of eHealth systems: The Sustainability of the Electronic Logistics Management Information System (eLMIS)
